paragraphs: Place the BMX SolidSafe Air 10K on the back of your iPhone, and it will keep it going for days. No cable is needed, and current flows quickly.
Plus, this power bank measures only half an inch (13 mm) thick, and the titanium exterior looks gorgeous. If that wasn’t enough, it’s safer than traditional lithium-ion cells.
I put the iPhone accessory through real-world testing. Here’s what I found.

Clever inventors found an amazing number of uses for the MagSafe magnets Apple built into iPhones: stands, wallets, keyboards, e-book readers and more. But the best use is power banks. Simply put a MagSafe battery on your iPhone to recharge it. There’s no need to go anywhere near a wall socket. You can even use your handset while it’s juicing up.

MagSafe power banks have been around for years, but they keep getting better. A great example of this is the new BMX SolidSafe Air 10K, which is easily portable but packs enough power to keep an iPhone going for a weekend. And the handset charges up quickly.
10,000mAh power bank in a titanium casing that's just 13mm thick. Full-day power that stays slim enough for daily carry.

The BMX SolidSafe Air 10K looks amazing. Most of the exterior is titanium that wraps around the front and all four sides of the accessory, with curved corners and edges. The product is as professional-looking as an iPhone user could wish for.
My review unit is silver, but the product also comes in black or gold.
